text:
sophia: heads-up from onboarding qx-lite-int4 bench: we're seeing token boundary drift when dynamic padding is enabled. dedupe fingerprints diverge unpredictably across paraphrases. tagging @labeling-team
ryan: can you paste an example pair? exact or near-dup?
sophia: example: "Cancel my subscription for plan B" vs "Please cancel plan B subscription". with dynamic padding on the runtime they end up with different anchor ids; without it they matched.
marta: so two failure modes: fragmentation (same paraphrase split across anchors) and collapse in other cases?
sophia: mostly fragmentation, but a few collapse cases too when padding trims/extends subword tokens. total flagged ~4.7k collisions/fragmentations in the experimental 200k prompt slice; ~320 anchors have golden labels.
leo: what's the proposed mitigation? re-run fingerprinting with tokenizer fixed, or change fingerprint algorithm to be padding-insensitive?
ryan: both are on table. short-term: targeted re-fingerprint only impacted anchors after we confirm no eval regressions. medium-term: add a padding-insensitive fallback fingerprint (char-norm + rolling hash) as a tie-breaker.
labeling-bot: export job queued: `export_prompts --set prompt_gold_main --filter "dynpad_delta=true" --out s3://redwood/tmp/dynpad_conflicts_1785.json` (job id: 8127)
sophia: i'll open a tiny repro PR with a script `tools/recompute_fp.py --dry-run --slice s3://...` that prints expected queue churn. keeps golden read-only by default.
marta: label ops note: contractors will need extra capacity if many anchors re-enter review. can ops-bot add calendar & runbook?
ops-bot: calendar event created: "qx-lite-int4 promptset rescue" tomorrow 09:30-12:30 PT. Runbook stub: https://go/ops/qx-dynpad-rescue.
leo: let's run an A/B on a 12k slice: control = current fingerprint; variant = control + padding-insensitive fallback for conflicts. metrics: anchor count delta, golden-anchor hits, label churn, eval delta on holdout.
ryan: I can kick off the A/B once PR lands. target: keep false merges <1% and eval delta <0.4% absolute.
sophia: governance: any golden edits require two approvers + provenance tag. i'll include migration metadata fields in the script: fingerprint_version, tokenizer_version, runtime_build.
marta: please include a dry-run that outputs a JSON patch of proposed golden edits so reviewers can inspect before any write.
sophia: will do. expected PR by EOD. updating this thread with links and A/B results. :thumbsup:
ryan: thanks all. if A/B looks good we can opt for partial migration (only anchors with conflicts) before a global recompute.
leo: also run quick checks against int8/fp16 snapshots to ensure no other quant profile regressions.
sophia: noted, adding sweep jobs to PR. will post logs here.
labeling-bot: reminder: do not apply golden changes until two approvals are recorded.
